== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Rise Of The Dark Lord (Errata)]] (<code>1271_19</code>, Virtual Block 7 slip 00), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 7.1 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-00-Rise_Of_The_Dark_Lord.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-D-riseofthedarklord-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[Rise Of The Dark Lord]]; the Master List (2013) reprints the original.

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205229/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-12-11] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111152155/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive); the Virtual master list (VMasterType) shows the same text from 2012-07-21 to 2013-01-11; the captures of March to May 2013 carry no game text. Published typos and punctuation are kept as printed; icons the source writes out in words are drawn as the slips print them.
* '''PC-E1 text (card list):''' “Deploy on table (deploys only at start of game) with three different [Vader] Effects from your Reserve Deck face down under here. Once per turn, may deploy a [Vader] Effect from here (never from elsewhere). Limit one [Vader] Effect on table and, when lost, stack it under here. You may cancel your [Vader] Effect at any time.Twisted And Evil: Dark Jedi Presence, Jedi Presence, Revenge Of The Sith and Sith Tests are canceled. When using The Empire's Back to deploy Vader from Reserve Deck, it is a Used Interrupt. If you just drew a [Vader] card for destiny, may take it into hand.”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1271_19</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 7 set mark, caption, copyright line) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB7-00-Rise_Of_The_Dark_Lord-PC-E1-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B32 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
